caption: The drawing features a single object, which is a sculpted dragon head viewed in profile, facing left. The dragon head is rendered in shades of off-white and light gray, with subtle shading to suggest three-dimensionality and depth. The head has an open mouth displaying a row of pointed teeth, a pronounced nostril above the upper jaw, and a series of smooth, rounded protrusions along the top of its snout and back of the head resembling stylized horns or scales. One circular or oval-shaped fin-like structure is present at the back. A wooden rectangular element, colored brown, is attached to the rear of the head, likely indicating the object’s base or mounting. The background consists of a uniform, textured area colored in muted blue, with no additional details, figures, or objects.
title: Gargoyle/Gutter Spout
